item.name: Knockdown Shooter
item.effectSummary: Boosts shooting success on contested and tough jump shots, with guides also describing better range or difficult-shot reliability.
item.bestFor: Players whose offense is built around pull-ups, spot-up looks, and late-clock jumpers.
item.avoidIf: You need paint pressure, rebounding help, or a team-support takeover more than shooting boosts.
item.cardSummary: Knockdown Shooter is the safest fit for perimeter scorers who want their takeover to turn hard jumpers into more reliable scoring chances.

item.name: Smooth Operator
item.effectSummary: Improves off-the-dribble shot creation and range for ball handlers who create their own looks.
item.bestFit: Point guards and scoring ball handlers
item.bestFor: Players who use dribble moves to create space before taking mid-range or perimeter shots.
item.avoidIf: You mostly run the offense for teammates or need a takeover that helps finishing, boards, or defense.
item.cardSummary: Smooth Operator fits guards who want takeover value while handling the ball, chaining moves, and creating shots without waiting for catch-and-shoot chances.

item.name: Unleash
item.effectSummary: Improves offensive production for self-creating point guards through better dribbling, shot creation, and scoring consistency.
item.bestFor: Ball handlers who want their takeover to make isolation possessions and self-created scoring feel stronger.
item.avoidIf: Your main value is pass-first playmaking or you need a clearer shooting, slashing, or rebounding specialization.
item.cardSummary: Unleash is a scoring-guard option for players who want a broader offensive takeover instead of a pure shooter or pure facilitator choice.

item.name: Highlight Reel
item.effectSummary: Boosts blow-by success, posterizer chances, and driving dunk strength for rim-attacking builds.
item.bestFor: Players who create pressure by beating defenders to the rim and finishing through contact.
item.avoidIf: Your build is more about perimeter shooting, passing, or rebounding than attacking the basket.
item.cardSummary: Highlight Reel is the clear slasher takeover: it rewards wings and athletic forwards that already want to turn a lane into a dunk.

item.name: Downhill
item.effectSummary: Improves blow-by success and speed with the ball so direct drives become harder to stop.
item.bestFit: Tall ball handlers and do-it-all forwards
item.bestFor: Players who attack from the perimeter, use speed with the ball, and force bigger defenders to guard movement.
item.avoidIf: You play mostly as a spot-up shooter, pure passer, or interior big instead of creating downhill pressure.
item.cardSummary: Downhill is for builds that win by moving with the ball, pushing past defenders, and turning size plus handle into rim pressure.

item.name: Team Riser
item.effectSummary: Helps pass-first guards elevate teammates instead of focusing only on their own scoring.
item.bestFor: Players who control the offense, move the ball, and want takeover value tied to team play.
item.avoidIf: You need a takeover for self-created buckets, shooting pressure, or finishing through contact.
item.cardSummary: Team Riser is the team-first point guard option when your build is meant to set up others rather than carry possessions alone.

item.name: Diesel
item.effectSummary: Adds contact-dunk and paint-dominance value for big builds that want to pressure the rim.
item.bestFor: Players who use size, strength, post control, and inside finishing to punish smaller defenders.
item.avoidIf: You would rather stretch the floor, chase rebounds, or support teammates with a utility takeover.
item.cardSummary: Diesel is the interior scoring takeover for bigs that want to turn strength and paint position into contact finishes.

item.name: Board Hunter
item.effectSummary: Shows where a missed shot will land before it comes off the rim, helping rebounders get position early.
item.bestFor: Players whose job is to secure boards, protect the paint, and prevent second-chance possessions.
item.avoidIf: Your build is not responsible for rebounding or you need scoring pressure from your takeover.
item.cardSummary: Board Hunter is the specialist rebounding option, giving bigs a clearer read on missed shots before everyone reacts.

item.name: Glue Guy
item.effectSummary: Improves loose-ball chasing, rebounding, and contest ability on both the perimeter and interior.
item.bestFor: Players who clean up misses, guard multiple spots, chase loose balls, and help without needing every shot.
item.avoidIf: You need a takeover built around pure scoring, pure shooting, or a single rebounding read.
item.cardSummary: Glue Guy is the all-around frontcourt utility option for builds that make winning plays through defense, boards, and hustle.
